messages:
Lana: Hi @people-ops — I want to request a formal accommodation. I have social anxiety that makes mandatory on-camera meetings and spoken performance feedback very stressful. I'd like 'video optional' for recurring meetings I'm required to attend and written-only feedback for the next review cycle. I can provide a clinician note if needed.

Elena (People Ops): Thanks for flagging this, Lana. We can kick off the interactive process. Quick Qs: 1) Which recurring meetings (names/recurrence) should be video optional? 2) Is written-feedback for all 1:1s or only formal performance reviews?

Lana: Mainly team standups (Mon/Wed 10am), the monthly all-hands, and my 1:1s with Todd. For feedback: preference is written for formal reviews and coaching conversations where possible.

Todd (manager): I support this. We'll add a note to recurring invites and mark your 1:1s as 'written summary first, optional follow-up call'. I'll update the calendar invites today.

Elena (People Ops): Sounds good. Please fill the accommodation form here: https://go.redwood.ops/accom-form and attach any documentation you want to share. We'll log the request, set a 6-week trial/check-in, and update the review workflow so reviewers can provide written comments with an optional meeting follow-up. We'll keep the record limited to manager+People Ops.

Lana: Form submitted and I attached a short clinician note. Thanks for making this easy.

Oncall-bot: /note Accommodation logged: Lana — video-optional (team standups, all-hands) + written-feedback trial through next review cycle. Case ID: AC-2026-0421.

Todd (manager): I've updated invites and added a 6-week check-in on my calendar (Thu 2026-05-28 10:30). I asked Sam to remind the standup hosts to respect the video-optional note this week. :thumbsup:

Lana: Appreciate it — thanks everyone :pray:
